purpose: Compose memory/storage and integration descriptors into an ordered unevaluated pipeline with memory before integration.

required.statement: Require one source-bound memory stage and one source-bound integration stage.
Preserve both opaque descriptors and require the memory stage before the integration stage.
Return the declared MemoryIntegrationOperatorPipeline deterministically with complete traceability.

forbidden.statement: Do not define the memory model, integration semantics, or stage signatures.
Do not execute stages, reverse their order, merge their identities, or invent aggregation behavior.

deferred.statement: memory_model, integration_semantics, and stage_signatures remain unresolved and require an external provider.

operations.purpose: Validate and compose two opaque descriptors with the sourced memory-before-integration order.

inputs.name: memory_stage
inputs.semantic_role: opaque memory or storage operator descriptor

fields.name: stages
fields.semantic_role: exact ordered memory and integration descriptors

preconditions.statement: Both stages are present, source-addressable, provenance-bearing, and assigned to their exact roles.

postconditions.statement: The result contains exactly two distinct stages ordered memory then integration without evaluation.
All source, unresolved, reservation, and assumption identities remain traceable.

invariants.statement: Memory and integration stage identities remain distinct.
The observable order is always memory before integration.
Opaque stage payloads remain unchanged and non-invoked.

steps: validate stage inputs and source bindings
place memory stage before integration stage

partial_order.before: validate stage inputs and source bindings
partial_order.after: place memory stage before integration stage

partial_order.before: place memory stage before integration stage

error_contract.condition: Source error identifier missing_memory_stage: the memory stage is absent.
Source error identifier missing_integration_stage: the integration stage is absent.
Source error identifier invalid_stage_order: the proposed observable order does not place memory before integration.

implementation_modes.statement: Implement the exact two-stage memory-before-integration result.
Do not supply memory, integration, or signature semantics.
Internal mechanisms are free provided the observable order and preservation contract hold.

global_invariants.statement: No memory model, integration semantics, stage signature, or aggregation is invented.
